items.summary: Retain a deferred GitHub-informed content-normalization opportunity using microsoft/markitdown. The CRO lab found MIT licensing, 194 files, 22 purpose-specific keyword hits, and 8/8 bounded checks passed without dependency installation; this supports prototyping, not adoption. Smallest reversible prototype: offline conversion and diff review for three existing content fixtures, with no production access or deployment. Measure valid output rate, editorial acceptance, and processing time. Security, parser, dependency, maintenance, and source-document handling risks require CTO review before adoption.
